scope: Recognized guest CPU/native fault delivery through original thread signal resources, precise forced siginfo, handler entry/return, terminal frame failures, nested faults and original diagnostics.

architecture.faults: Source and solo share classification and forced-thread-fault queue policy. Memory/unmapped/protected/file-SIGBUS, instruction/trap and rejected-native faults complete on the original executor with its existing View. Host failures remain host failures.
architecture.signals: KILL then precise private fault then ordinary pending signals. A prior asynchronous signal of the same number is replaced only in the original thread inbox; shared signal info is retained. Blocked/ignored/default synchronous faults terminate the original group.
architecture.frames: The same ABI handles PC/register/SP/mask/alternate stack and SME records. Invalid sigreturn preserves its existing source errno plus pending SIGSEGV. Failed frame entry/nesting terminates the original group without stopping an unrelated actor.
architecture.diagnostics: Caught faults use the existing bounded original log and live task name. Fatal diagnostics keep final retirement publication. The idle source selector reads the existing two pending bitsets without taking signal locks.
